title: Willesden Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, and essential supply points for Willesden and Harlesden.
content:
For life-threatening medical emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, London W2 1NY. From Willesden Junction station: ~15 mins on the Bakerloo line or London Overground south-east to Paddington, or bus 18 south-east along Harrow Road (~25 mins).
- Northwick Park Hospital: Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ. From Dollis Hill station: ~15 mins via Jubilee line north to Wembley Park then Metropolitan line to Northwick Park; or bus 182 from Harlesden Jubilee Clock (~25 mins).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Central Middlesex Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Acton Lane, Park Royal NW10 7NS. From Harlesden station: ~15 min walk west along Acton Lane, or bus 187, 224, or 260 west (~5 mins).
- Willesden Centre for Health and Care (Urgent Treatment Centre): Robson Avenue, Willesden NW10 3RY. From Willesden Green station: ~15 min walk west along High Road and Robson Avenue, or bus 260 or 266.

3. Local Hazard Notes
- Grand Union Canal corridor in southern Harlesden and railway cuttings near Willesden Junction present surface drainage and localized flood risks during intense rainfall.

4. Essential Supplies
- Pharmacies and large stores along Willesden High Road, Walm Lane (Willesden Green), and Park Parade / High Street Harlesden supply drinking water, first-aid goods, and medicines during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
